book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: JA' AN CARTA TET EB CREYENTE HEBREO

content: Manchej Cu Bej Cu Teynen Cu Colbanil
Ja' naj Sc'aal Dios, miman yel oc apnoj naj yintaj eb ángel. Yuxan sowalil chi cu na'tej wan jix kabe, yu c'am chi cu jitzwi el yin cu colbanil.
Ja' wan sk'ane Dios jix yal wan ángel yet peyxa tu', caw yel wan k'ane tu'. Ta ey mac c'am chi jijen wan k'ane tu', catu' chi yunen spenail, chi ẍa' spaj jun jun eb.

Ta cha'bil spaj yu eb. ¿Tzet utbil chi yun keltej yalan jun miman sya'ilal oj tit kiban xin, ta c'am chi cu teyne jun miman colbanile ti'? Ja' ton naj Kaawil jix alon yu jun colbanile ti' yet sbabelal. Ja' eb jix aben tzet jix yal naj, ja' eb jix tx'oxon kil tol caw yel wan k'ane ti'.

Catu' x'oxnaj pax cu Mam Dios e on, tol caw yel wan k'ane ti', yetoj wan tx'oxbanile chi q'uey a cu c'ul yu yet chi kiloni, yetoj swatx' c'ulal yetoj wan smilagro. Ja' pax Santo Espíritu, x'oxnaj kil wej tol yel wan k'ane ti', yutol chi yak' kopiso naj jun jun jon. Ja'ta'c'ala' tzet opisoal chi el yin sc'ul naj chi yak' e on jun jun jon.
Man oj yak' cu Mam Dios jun ac' yul yiban k'inal tol to oj jul oj yul sk'ab eb ángel. Ja' yin jun tu', lalan cu k'anab tinani',
pero ja' yul An Juun Tz'ibebil can oj, albil can yu jun mac txequel jaxca ti':

content.text: ¿Tzet yel oc apnoj wan ánima ti', cha na', jaach Dios, yuxan cha na'tej eb, ma jun yuninal ánima tu', yuxan cha teyne?
Txene tiempoal xa waon canon naj yintaj eb ángel.
Jix ja wak' watx'ilal yetoj i'oeybail tet naj.
Jix ja waoc naj Yaawil oj yiban masanil tzettaj yetal jix ja wa'ne.
Masanil c'al jix ja wak' can yalan naj, ẍi yul An Juun.

content: Chi yal jaxca tu', tol jix ak'le can masanil tzettaj yetal yul sk'ab eb ánima yu Dios. C'am junoj tzet yetal ma ak'le can yul sk'ab eb. Pero xin, chi kila, tol c'am to chi sjije masanil tzettaj yetal eb ánima tinani'.

Pero chi kil naj Jesús. Jix ak'le naj yalan eb ángel yet ey oc smimanil naj jaxca ánima yin txene tiempoal yu Dios. Yu swatx' c'ulal Dios yin eb ánima, yuxan jix ak'le cam naj Jesús yu masanil eb. Ja' tinani', jix can can watx'ilal yetoj i'oeybail yin naj Jesús yutol jix yab sya'il camich naj.

Masanil tzettaj yetal wa'nebil yu Dios, c'al masanil tzettaj yetal chi steyne Dios. Catu' chi yoche Dios chi yi' swatx'ilal masanil eb yuninal. Yuxan smoo jix wa'xi naj Jesús yin tz'ajanil yu Dios, yutol ja' naj chi oc colwawomal yin eb. Jix wa'xi naj yin tz'ajanil yu yilon sya'ilal.

Ja' Jesús chi cu sic'on el yu koc yetoj Dios. Ja' mac jon sic'bil jon tu', yetoj jun mac chi sic'on el tu', ja' c'al oc cu Mam. Yuxan c'am chi q'uixwi naj Sc'aal Dios cu yalon oc yuẍtaj oj ma yanab oj.
Quey tu' yalon naj tet Smam yul An Juun:

content.text: Oj wal tet eb wuẍtaj, eb wanab ja wu.
Oj jin bit'ne wan bit' e ach an xol eb ánima yaman oc oj, ẍi naj tet Smam.
Oj waoc Dios yip oj jin c'ul. Jix yalon junel xa:
Ey jin ec' xol eb wuninal jix yak' Dios e in an, ẍi Cristo yul An Juun.

content: Masanil eb uninale junne mimanile ye oc eb. Quey ton tu' naj Jesús, jix yi' smimanil naj jaxca ánima. Jix yi' smimanil naj, yuxan jix ske' scam naj yu stantzele el naj yaaw camich, ja' ton naj diablo.
Quey ton tu', jix yun yel can xiw c'ulal eb ánima chi cami.
C'am chi jul naj yu scolcha eb ángel. Jix jul naj yu scolcha eb yic'aal naj Abraham.

Yu ton jun ti' xin, yuxan sowalil jix yi' smimanil naj jaxca eb yuẍtaj naj. Yu yoc naj Yaawil oj yak'omal xaambal tet Dios yu eb ánima. Jun chi ok' sc'ul yin eb, catu' jichan chi yute sbeybal yin smulnail. Ja' naj jix yak' cam sba yin xaambalil yu yel can spenail eb ánima.
Ja' naj Jesús, jix yil sya'ilal, catu' jix ak'le porobal, pero ma ey q'uey oj. Yuxan chi ske' scolwa yin eb ánima yet chi jul sya'ilal yiban eb, ma yet chi ak'le porobal.
